text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spring GⅠ races begin. First, Kitasan 
Black takes on the Osaka Hai, followed by 
Satono Diamond challenging the Satsuki 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following strong performances in the 
Kikuka Sho and the Arima Kinen, rumors 
began circulating that the distance might 
be too short for her. However, Kitasan 
Black entered the race completely unfazed.
